profile.org_note: Minto Communities USA is the US homebuilding arm of the Ottawa-based Minto Group. Under President William Bullock it is organised by function, not geography: one division president for Acquisitions & Development (Dutch Neuweiler, the land decision-maker) and one for Operations (Steve Svopa, all homebuilding), plus a senior vice president who runs the Westlake master development (John Carter). No US-level CFO or treasurer is named publicly; finance leadership that is public sits at the parent (CFO Paul Baron, CIO Glen MacMullin). The company's careers feed shows a Land Finance Manager role in Tampa that underwrites land acquisitions across the US (posted July 2026) and a Waxahachie Land Development Manager reporting to a Director of Community Development (posted August 2026); search snippets of other postings (not opened) also mention a Director of Land Finance in Tampa and a Vice President of Land Development over Texas. None of these holders is named.
profile.summary: US arm of Canada's family-owned Minto Group, building master-planned and 55+ communities in Florida and South Carolina and now entering Texas; the parent's CEO put 2024 at 2,385 homes delivered and $1.42 billion of revenue (February 2025 company release). It is a land-heavy master developer rather than a lot-option builder: its land head says Minto 'owns the land, develops the property and builds the homes', and in 2026 it closed outright on 3,170 acres in Waxahachie (13,270 homes planned) and 1,318 acres in Texas City (about 3,500 homes, Latitude Margaritaville Galveston Bay). The Latitude Margaritaville communities are built under license from Margaritaville Holdings, with The St. Joe Company as partner at Watersound.

people.name: Dutch Neuweiler
people.title: Division President, Acquisitions & Development
people.prior_role: Latitude Margaritaville senior director of land development (promoted May 2018); before that Minto Director of Acquisition and Development
people.source_title: Minto press release: Minto Communities Closes On 1,318-Acre Site For First Latitude Margaritaville Community In Texas
people.note: The land call. Company voice on every 2026 land deal: Waxahachie, TX (3,170 acres, closed 2026-02-20), Texas City, TX (1,318 acres, closed 2026-10-20) and Latitude Margaritaville Watersound Phase Two. Title also published as 'Division President of Acquisition and Development' (2026-09-17) and plain 'Division President' (January-February 2026); first seen with a Division President title in the 2026-01-29 release. Heads both acquisition and land development for Minto USA. 'Dutch' is the name the company publishes; the Texas Comptroller officer list for Minto Communities Texas, LLC (2024) shows a 'Theodore Neuweiler' as vice president, probably the same person (not confirmed). Reporting line inferred from titles.

people.note: Appointed April 2022 to lead Texas land positioning and build the Texas development team. The title source is over 24 months old. The Texas Comptroller officer list for Minto Communities Texas, LLC (2024 report year) still shows a Scott Rogers as vice president, but no 2025-2026 source names him and the 2026 Texas announcements quote Dutch Neuweiler instead, so confirm he is still in the seat. A search-result snippet of a February 2026 Minto job posting (Director of Community Development, Southlake, TX; posting itself could not be opened) refers to an unnamed 'Vice President of Land Development'. Published inbox for Texas land offers: TexasInfo@mintousa.com (2022 release).
